note: Syria (civil war from March 2011). UCDP Georeferenced Event Dataset: events of organised violence (state-based conflict, non-state conflict and one-sided violence against civilians) that caused at least one death, in Syria, 2011-03 to 2026-08. Sources: UCDP GED Global 26.1 (to December 2025) plus UCDP Candidate monthly releases for 2026 (26.01.26.06, 26.0.7, 26.0.8; last month covered 2026-08). Candidate events are preliminary and may be revised or removed in the next GED release, and are less complete than the annual GED. 87462 events (GED 26.1: 87075, Candidate 26.01.26.06: 284, Candidate 26.0.7: 51, Candidate 26.0.8: 52; state-based 72844, non-state 10246, one-sided 4372), best-estimate deaths 330,030. Events are placed at their coded location (often a town or a province centroid when the exact place is unknown); 1209 of 88671 events coded only to country level or to international waters/airspace are left out. Only events UCDP codes to country 'Syria' are included. Month is the event's start date. Cells are grid squares; lon/lat give the cell centre. Cell size 0.25 deg. Values are UCDP's best estimate of deaths (combatants and civilians), which is uncertain; UCDP also gives low and high estimates.
vUnits: UCDP best-estimate deaths per cell and month
